about: Signature behaviours, wave 2, the small bodies (arthropods, moths, frogs): the plans and the usual weight of the templates new in src/ark-scene/recipe-small.ts (read by scripts/ark-signature-recipes.mts, which has no users yet to learn them from), and the body plans a wave-1 template is also checked on, in the behaviours harness's frames (scripts/ark-behaviours-clips.mjs, the sm-* scenes).
